integrity.claim_scope: A unique stationary-weight parity formula for every integer number of peer updates and every finite connected reciprocal bipartite network; explicit star specialization.
integrity.computational_checks: 4752 exact rational stationary-weight, resolvent and conservation comparisons, plus exact star identities; finite checks are not the general proof.
integrity.unproved_limits: No claim of empirical prediction, full stochastic social dynamics, or consensus at finite common platform susceptibility.

scientific_limitations: Exact finite-graph result assumes connected reciprocal bipartite networks and classwise-constant interior peer susceptibilities.

Consensus selection is for the high common platform-susceptibility limit, or for fully susceptible platform iteration started at the innate opinion vector; finite platform susceptibility generally retains disagreement.
Noisy, directed, non-bipartite, within-class heterogeneous, or empirical social networks are not covered.
Historical originality is bounded by the inspected publications; independent scientific audit and priority review have not been performed.
title: A parity law for consensus selection in bipartite predictive opinion loops
